parts.t: Bright & spacious corner 2 bdrm 2 bath condo. Tranquil living on your large deck listening to the birds in the nearby trees. Kitchen features a dishwasher, new induction stove, and new black stainless refrigerator. Living room boasts a cozy gas fireplace, laminate wood flooring, large windows over looking the tennis court and green space. New blinds & drapes. Peaceful and spacious primary bedroom w/ its own access to the deck, plus a walk thru closet to the 2nd full bathroom.  2nd bdrm also opens out to the deck. Full size new washer/ dryer. Condo has just been painted throughout! Included are one, same floor storage locker and one secured parking stall. Pet friendly!
